title: Phonelink
missing: Backend missing. Click for guided service installation.
upgrade: Backend update required. Click for service setup.
stopped: Service stopped. Click for service setup.
unavailable: Service unavailable. Check systemctl --user status phonelink.service.
runtime: Cannot coordinate tray mode. Check the graphical session runtime directory.
clickHint: Click to open Phonelink · Right-click for service setup · Middle-click to refresh
serviceError: Cannot start the user service. Right-click the Phonelink bar icon for setup, or check systemctl --user status phonelink.service.
setupHint: Right-click the Phonelink bar icon for guided service setup. Review the detected installation, dependencies and startup choice before confirming.
installExplanation: Build and install the bundled service for this user. The current service stays available during the build; replacing it briefly stops it. No sudo or separate backend download is used. Review the locations and startup choice, then confirm.
setupFooter: Closing this panel does not cancel an approved install. Cancel stops the job and restores the previous installation when needed. Phone debugging is a separate setup step.
phase_failed: Installation failed. Review details and retry.
phase_interrupted: Installer interrupted. Backups retained; review before retrying.
blocked_managed: A system-managed or custom installation was detected. Use its existing update process; this flow will not create a competing copy.
blocked_dependencies: Dependencies are missing. Review the command below or copy instructions for your agent to approve.
blocked_session: The graphical user session is not active. Check your Omarchy/systemd session setup.
setupError_helper: Could not run setup. Python 3 and the bundled plugin files are required.
setupError_recovery: An interrupted replacement needs recovery before a new install. Backups are retained in the setup cache; copy instructions for your agent.
setupError_managed: Update the existing system/custom installation instead.
setupError_session: Check the graphical session before installation.
setupError_worker: Could not start the installation worker.
setupError_setup: Setup could not complete. Check file permissions and service status.
agentIntro: Please help me install or update the Phonelink user service from the bundled repository source. Explain your plan and ask me to approve any privileged dependency installation.
dependencyHelp: Check README installation requirements and the installed user service before making changes.
consent: Do not delete phone data or ADB keys, replace a system-managed installation, or run privileged commands without my approval.
